edges.reason: msg.sender is only checked against Init.friendlyaddress before the caller supplied userAddress is mutated.
msg.sender passes the friendly whitelist before userAddress storage is popped.
msg.sender whitelist check gates order creation which uses caller supplied order data.
msg.sender whitelist check gates the release of wrapped tokens on expiry.
msg.sender whitelist check gates cancellation and pool removal.
msg.sender is used as owner/spender context in transferFrom allowance accounting.
msg.sender is cached as _msgSender and used as deposit owner.
msg.sender is cast to payable msgSender and used for all withdrawal accounting.
renounceRole compares the account argument with _msgSender derived from msg.sender.
ECO reward computation uses now minus stored deposit time, miner influenceable.
Aggregate ECO earnings are derived from timestamp based rewards.
Dues paid count comparison uses now - matchOrder.time, timestamp dependent lock decision.
dueCheck requires now >= time + duesPaid * 30 days before expiring an order.
orderExpired requires matchOrderMap.expiryDate <= now, timestamp gated release.
matchOrder sets time to now and expiryDate to now + duration * 30 days.
Order id is derived from now, timestamps determine order identity collisions.

normalization_plan.reason: The freePusher userAddress parameter is the identity target of the freePusher state mutation.
The freePusher _amount parameter flows directly into freePusher accounting.
The amountLeft local variable is the loop accumulator inside freePopper.
The orderExpired _orderId parameter indexes the matched order released by orderExpired.
The Withdraw _amount parameter drives the withdrawal flow.
The availableBalance local variable is used only inside Withdraw to select the payout branch.
The payDue msgSender parameter is the payer identity consumed by payDue.
The Deposit _amount parameter is the deposit amount consumed by Deposit.
